question: Where a loaded game's theatre headquarters are put, and what entering does to a theatre's provinces.

addresses.name: CTheatre_PickHQProvince
addresses.comment: **Where a new theatre headquarters goes.** Over the +0x60 provinces with effective infrastructure (infrastructure x (1000 + local + global) / 1000, held to 10..1000) of at least 200 (VA 0x1A86EAC), simulated and stamped with the theatre, none with an enemy land unit or an enemy fleet carrying land units (CNavy +0x2EC) beside it (any edge) and none with a land battle: the first is the fallback; the least of |150 - mean CMap::DistanceBetweenProvinces to the front provinces|, x4 bordering a front province, x2 bordering another holder's land, /3 its controller's capital, x100 on a front, first of equals. `ret 4`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-theatres.md, section K. **Confirmed live 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 44): each candidate's score at the comparison (0xB0EEB, the score in ESI, the province in EDI) agrees with this account to the unit for China's, Mongolia's and Britain's theatres on entering July 1941; it is also what slot 82 (CAIUnit_PickCommandProvince) uses for a theatre agent, and there it answers each existing headquarters' own province.
addresses.evidence: Scores logged at 0xB0EEB and the pick after 0x4C0775 on the running game, entering Ireland1941_07_16_07, 2026-11-11.
